Dramatic professional studio lighting, controlled highlights, deep charcoal background, refined shadows, subtle atmospheric haze. Photorealistic glass and metallic materials, sophisticated premium product photography, elegant minimalist composition. Strong product-centered visual hierarchy, beautiful contrast, carefully balanced negative space suitable for later advertising typography. Original generic packaging design, blank label, no recognizable product shapes associated with existing brands, no text, no logos, no trademarks. Portrait orientation, 4:5.
